text: No shipped documentation instructs a reader to call a function absent from the pinned dependency

state.evidence: `cli_command_helper.ex` `@moduledoc` ((A31). The example called `Arca.Config.get_config_location/0`, which is not defined anywhere in the pinned arca_config (`function_exported?` false at runtime) and exists only in the unreleased one; `cli_command_helper.ex` ships in `lib/`. It now uses `Arca.Config.Cfg.config_file/0`, present in both.)
